body:
Evidence-first review of PR #1 (riatzukiza/eros-eris-field, base 3af779f3, head b9684c4) — a documentation/planning change: new owning plan (393 lines) + proposed ABI EDN (115 lines, :unimplemented), new pinned eta-mu evidence-review workflow, byte-identical auto-merge rename to .disabled, two bounded .gitignore entries, new AGENTS.md, rewritten agent-workflows.md, 8 evidence JSONs, and append-only receipts (9) / reflections (8). All 14 full-diff pages (16 changed files, 1215+/101-) were read and assessed.

Deterministic evidence: exact-head clean checkout; diff_stat, diff_hygiene, and the nbb ABI-EDN parse all exited 0 with no errors. Independently verified against the tree: plan↔ABI agreement on all ten declared functions (including the newly declared restore and confirm-feedback), quantum/substeps, xorshift32 parameters, layer keys, safe-integer range, replay tolerances, exchange min() formula, and the deflection convention (worked examples arithmetic checked); no license file/package license field; external tsconfig path; graph-ant Math.random; referenced workflow files present; agents/muse pins in the caller match this run's .review-context metadata exactly; no credential material in the tree; base ignore prefixes preserved.

Candidates (5) — all classified before the adversarial note, none confirmed:
- Rejected: read-recall purity-declaration asymmetry (plan states the guarantee; ABI defers to plan, marks itself non-schema); read-recall trace-output omission (state carries the trace; plan's ABI bullet maps one-to-one); pinned external workflow's recorded Unicode clean-tree defect (caller-side ignores + post-mitigation hosted runs passed that step; defect tracked upstream and honestly disclosed); the committed CodeRabbit apply-outcome writer-acknowledgement finding (settled in this head by :confirm-feedback, matching plan prose and the RED matrix).
- Needs-human, non-blocking: whether ETA_MU_APP_PRIVATE_KEY is scoped away from the evidence-gate npx step inside the pinned external reusable workflow (45ec644c) cannot be settled without inspecting that blob; author receipts cite a hash-bound inspection claiming isolation, fork PRs receive no secrets, and no exposure is demonstrated.

Non-blocking notes: no gate parses receipts.edn, ledger.md or the evidence JSONs (only the ABI EDN is parsed) — no demonstrated regression, so a summary note only; the PR body's changed-input enumeration and head metadata (13 inputs/7 receipts/6 reflections, head 81477e7) are stale relative to the reviewed head (16 files/9 receipts/8 reflections at b9684c4) — untrusted metadata, with the diff authoritative and all three extra evidence files assessed; Foresight PR22/PR26 links were unreachable from this environment and treated as cited observations only.

No confirmed findings; implementation RED/GREEN, licensing adoption, calibration, and Rheos readiness remain explicitly open gates per the plan itself. Verdict: APPROVE.
